findings.source_quote: “God is willing that we should sacrifice the shimmering sunshine of today for the fullness of His presence tomorrow.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “tutekeleze jua linalong’aa la leo” with “tujinyime mwanga unaong’aa wa leo” or another natural rendering of sacrificing/giving up today’s sunshine.
findings.translation_quote: “Mungu yuko tayari tutekeleze jua linalong’aa la leo kwa ajili ya utimilifu wa uwepo wake kesho.”
